title: ‘Naruto’ Movie Launches Global Casting Search to Find Actors to Play Live-Action Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura
content:
ByZack Sharf

Digital News Director

The live-action “Naruto” movie is launching a worldwide casting search to find its three leading actors. The adaptation of Masashi Kishimoto’s classic manga is backed by Lionsgate. The casting search will fill the roles of Team 7: Naruto, Sasuke and Sakura. Additional casting for supporting roles will follow.Destin Daniel Cretton, the filmmaker behind Marvel’s “Shang-Chi” and the upcoming “Spider-Man: Brand New Day, is writing and directing the project.

“Kishimoto-sensei’s stories have inspired generations of fans around the world, and it’s an honor to bring his world and characters to the big screen in live action for the very first time,” Cretton said in a statement. “I’m thrilled to kick off this worldwide casting search for our Team 7 and to bring the incredible universe of ‘Naruto’ to life!”

Naruto creator Masashi Kishimoto added: “Right now, miracles are happening to me, one after another. My work, ‘Naruto’ is truly, truly becoming a Hollywood movie! And an even greater miracle is that the film will be directed by the one and only Destin Daniel Cretton. I still cannot believe it! If so many miracles have already come together, then let us hope for even more. I am eagerly looking forward to the miraculous encounters that will bring us extraordinary and passionate actors! I cannot wait to meet my characters in the film!”

Lionsgateannouncedthe live-action “Naruto” movie in February 2024. The manga has printed over 250 million copies in more than 60 countries and territories. It follows adolescent ninja Naruto Uzumaki, who dreams of becoming his community’s protector and leader known as the village ninja.

Avi Arad, Ari Arad and Emmy Yu will produce for Arad Productions with Jeremy Latcham. Cretton is producing alongside Jeyun Munford through his company, Hisako. Cretton previously collaborated with Lionsgate on “The Glass Castle.” The studio previously tried to get a “Naruto” movie off the ground in 2014 wheni itsigned Michael Graceyto direct.
title_zh: 《火影忍者》(Naruto) 電影啟動全球選角，尋找演員飾演真人版的鳴人(Naruto)、佐助(Sasuke)和小櫻(Sakura)。
content_zh:
由扎克·沙夫(Zack Sharf)報導

數位新聞總監

真人版《火影忍者》(Naruto) 電影正在啟動全球選角，尋找三位主要演員。這部改編自岸本齊史(Masashi Kishimoto)經典漫畫的電影由獅門影業(Lionsgate)支持。此次選角將填補第七班的角色：鳴人(Naruto)、佐助(Sasuke)和小櫻(Sakura)。隨後將進行配角的選角工作。執導這部作品的導演是曾執導漫威《尚氣》(Shang-Chi) 和即將上映的《蜘蛛人：全新的一天》(Spider-Man: Brand New Day) 的德斯汀·丹尼爾·克雷頓(Destin Daniel Cretton)。

克雷頓在一份聲明中表示：“岸本老師的故事激勵了全球幾代粉絲，能夠首次將他的世界和角色以真人版呈現在大銀幕上，這是一種榮幸。我非常高興能啟動這次全球選角，為我們的第七班帶來《火影忍者》的精彩宇宙！”

《火影忍者》創作者岸本齊史(Masashi Kishimoto)補充道：“現在，奇蹟一個接著一個地發生在我身上。我的作品《火影忍者》真的、真的要變成好萊塢電影了！更大的奇蹟是這部電影將由唯一的德斯汀·丹尼爾·克雷頓執導。我仍然無法相信！如果這麼多奇蹟已經聚集在一起，那麼讓我們期待更多。我迫不及待想要見到那些能帶來非凡和熱情的演員！我等不及要在電影中見到我的角色了！”

獅門影業(Lionsgate)在2024年2月宣布了真人版《火影忍者》(Naruto) 電影的計劃。這部漫畫在60多個國家和地區印刷了超過2.5億本。故事講述了少年忍者鳴人(Naruto Uzumaki)，他夢想成為社區的保護者和領導者，即村莊的忍者。

阿維·阿拉德(Avi Arad)、阿里·阿拉德(Ari Arad)和余艾米(Emmy Yu)將與傑瑞米·拉查姆(Jeremy Latcham)為阿拉德製作公司(Arad Productions)製作。克雷頓則通過他的公司Hisako與傑雲·曼福德(Jeyun Munford)共同製作。克雷頓之前曾與獅門影業(Lionsgate)合作過《玻璃城堡》(The Glass Castle)。該影業在2014年曾嘗試啟動《火影忍者》電影，當時簽約了邁克爾·格雷斯(Michael Gracey)執導。
